subject.title: fix(wechat): preserve existing accounts across hot reload

question: Should this WeChat hot-reload lifecycle fix require redacted live A+B provider proof, or may it merge on the supplied gateway regression, typecheck, and build evidence?
rationale: The remaining gap is provider-owned runtime behavior that the contributor cannot truthfully reproduce from their automation environment; accepting test-only evidence is a maintainer risk decision.

options.title: Require live WeChat proof
options.body: Ask someone with a real QR-login setup to attach redacted evidence that adding account B does not take account A offline.

options.title: Accept gateway-level proof
options.body: Explicitly waive live provider proof and merge only after the refreshed exact-head checks and merge result are clean.

recommendation.title: Require live WeChat proof
recommendation.body: Ask someone with a real QR-login setup to attach redacted evidence that adding account B does not take account A offline.

likelyOwner.reason: The initial PR timeline explicitly routed discussion to this likely repository decision contact; current-file ownership could not be established from the available read-only evidence.
